capability: Open memory in layers, summary first
title: Start with the small card.

hook.picture: Close on the whale pouring a huge stack of note cards onto a pod. The pod staggers, reads, and turns a rust ✕. The one key card lies at the bottom.
hook.words: I gave it all my notes.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: I gave it all my notes, and it missed the key fact.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: student feeding course notes to a chatbot

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: three tries. Each pours more cards on the pod; the key card sinks deeper (2 beats). It repeats, faster each time.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: More pages bury the one you need.

stakes.body: More context costs more and answers worse, and the one fact that mattered never gets read.

solution_hint: Start small. Open more only if needed.

metaphor.body: The cards stack into four layers on the line: one small summary card on top, then notes, full text, the original. The pod goes down one layer at a time, only as far as it needs. Rust alarm.

steps.picture: The cards settle into four layers on the line: one small summary card on top, then source notes, then full text, then the original page.
steps.words: Start with the short summary card.

steps.picture: The pod reads only the top card. A ring marks the one topic it needs.
steps.words: Read the top. Pick what you need.

steps.picture: Push-in: the pod goes down one layer, opens one source note, and finds the key fact. Every other layer stays closed.
The four layers are labelled: Summary · Notes · Full text · Original.

real_case.claim: Levels: topic summary, source notes, full fetched text, original URL; agents descend only as needed. Status: design / speculation, partly validated.

source.title: Memory System Design (FRONTIER Research Graph, Meta Layer)

honest_limit.picture: A summary card leaves out one small detail. The top looks complete, so the pod never goes down. The detail stays in layer three, and the pod turns rust ✕.
honest_limit.words: If the summary drops it, nobody looks.

not_this.body: A short summary is not the whole.

ending_pattern.body: The heap from act 1 is replaced by one small card; the pod lifts the key fact up from one layer down.
ending_pattern.callback: Act 1's heap with the key card at the bottom becomes one card, with the key fact lifted to the top.

end_belief.body: Give the short version first. Then go deeper.

score_self.reason: Every learner has dumped notes into a chatbot, so the felt pain lands. The layer picture is simple. The case is a design that is partly tested, and the card says so. The limit is honest.
